content.text:
I'd go with Harel's מניות (shares) track in קופת גמל להשקעה. I'm fairly sure, but only for that one product. That's the tab the page opened on, and I never got to see what my own קרן השתלמות offers. What decided it is that every track costs about the same, 0.54% to 0.61% "מהחיסכון" and 0% "מההפקדה". So the fee didn't separate them, and the return did. מניות shows "24.04%" for 3 years and "14.64%" for 5 years, the biggest numbers on the screen. The heading over those numbers says "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול", so it's per year and before fees. The S&P 500 track that my friends go on about shows "13.7%" and "11.92%", which is good but lower. So that's the first thing I'd do. Honestly, though, "קופת גמל להשקעה" still sounds like a pension thing for older people to me.

**What I looked at, in order:**
- The heading "הראל". The grey lines under it I skipped.
- The product buttons. "קופת גמל להשקעה 16" was already picked. Next to it were קרן השתלמות 16, the pension ones, and חיסכון לכל ילד. My screens never showed what's inside the קרן השתלמות tab.
- "16 מסלולים · דמי ניהול מההחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%". That line basically told me fees aren't the issue here.
- The table: for each row I read the track name on the right, then the fee, then the return.
  - Most rows just say "פחות מ־3 שנים" (under 3 years), so there's nothing to compare for those.
  - The ones with numbers: מניות 24.04/14.64, S&P 500 13.7/11.92, כללי 13.5/8.26, הלכה 11.42/5.73, אשראי ואג"ח עם מניות 8.6/4.73, כספי (שקלי) 4.25/3.08, and קיימות 1.78 for 3 years only.
- The money column on the far left ("כסף מנוהל"): I only glanced at it, things like "431 מיליון ₪". I don't know what it means for me.

**What I skipped:**
- The tiny line about "התקרה בחוק" (the legal cap on fees) and the "PF-10" note.
- The grey sentence under the table.
- Everything under "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל" (what Harel's documents say), and the search box at the bottom.
- The folded sections "קרנות מחקות 5 קרנות", "מרכזית לפיצויים" and "קרנות סל 4 קרנות". I almost opened קרנות סל, because that's the ETF thing, but the label doesn't say what it costs or how it did.

**Words I didn't get:** "מט"ח" next to each donut (I guessed it means foreign currency), "סחיר", "עוקב מדדים - גמיש", "אשראי ואג"ח", "מרכזית לפיצויים", and "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים".

**What bothered me:**
- Every row repeats "ההפקדה 0%", "מניות / מט"ח" with the colored dots, and "פחות מ־3 שנים" twice. I kept rereading the same stuff to find what was actually different between rows.
- The donuts are teal and yellow, and the only thing that tells you which color is which is the little dots next to the percentages. I had to look back and forth to match them.
- The fees only appear as percentages. There's no shekel amount, so they feel like nothing.
- It only shows one product at a time, so seeing "everything Harel offers" would mean tapping through five more tabs. On the bus, I'd stop after this one.
